components.name: Intent Classifier
components.description: Classifies customer intent using structured LLM output and routes to appropriate handler

components.name: Supervisor
components.description: Orchestrates deep agents based on classified intent using Command primitive

components.name: Synthesizer
components.description: Merges results from multiple agents using Generator-Critic-Revise pattern

components.name: Main Graph
components.description: Assembles all agents, subgraphs, and edges into the main StateGraph

components.name: WebSocket Handler
components.description: FastAPI WebSocket endpoint with streaming support via astream_events

dataFlow.description: Message received and passed to Intent Classifier node
Classifier produces IntentClassification with structured output
Simple intents routed to Level 1 Agent; complex to Supervisor
Supervisor delegates to appropriate Deep Agent subgraph
Deep Agent executes tools and produces response
Response streamed back to client via WebSocket
State checkpointed to PostgreSQL for persistence
